# Quantum Open Problems

> A source-audited catalog of formal open problems across quantum science. Records separate the formal target, original source, unresolved remainder, dated evidence, and editorial status.

Use the compact index for discovery, then fetch one problem record or Markdown research brief. Each active problem has three representations: an HTML page at `/problems/<record-id>/`, a JSON record at `/api/v1/problems/<record-id>.json`, and a Markdown research brief at `/packets/<record-id>.md`. Check the verification date and source relationship before relying on a status. Human and AI contributions use the same evidence contract.

## Machine interfaces

- [Agent guide](https://naixu-guo.github.io/quantum-information-open-problems/ai/): MCP server setup, endpoint map, research loop, and contribution contract.
- [MCP server](https://github.com/Naixu-Guo/quantum-information-open-problems/blob/main/mcp/server.mjs): Zero-dependency stdio server; add with `claude mcp add quantum-open-problems -- npx -y github:Naixu-Guo/quantum-information-open-problems`.
- [API guide](https://naixu-guo.github.io/quantum-information-open-problems/api/v1/README.md): Endpoint map and interpretation rules.
- [Release manifest](https://naixu-guo.github.io/quantum-information-open-problems/api/v1/release.json): Catalog date, digest, and counts; poll this before downloading more.
- [Compact catalog](https://naixu-guo.github.io/quantum-information-open-problems/api/v1/index.json): Discovery metadata for active problems.
- [Full snapshot](https://naixu-guo.github.io/quantum-information-open-problems/api/v1/problems.jsonl): One complete JSON problem record per line.
- [Evidence log](https://naixu-guo.github.io/quantum-information-open-problems/api/v1/evidence.json): Every dated evidence event, newest first.
- [Evidence feed](https://naixu-guo.github.io/quantum-information-open-problems/feed.xml): Atom feed of the latest evidence events; [JSON Feed](https://naixu-guo.github.io/quantum-information-open-problems/feed.json) carries the same entries.
- [Full catalog text](https://naixu-guo.github.io/quantum-information-open-problems/llms-full.txt): Every research brief concatenated in one Markdown file.
- [Problem schema](https://naixu-guo.github.io/quantum-information-open-problems/api/v1/problem.schema.json): Versioned JSON Schema for problem records.
- [Contribution schema](https://naixu-guo.github.io/quantum-information-open-problems/api/v1/contribution.schema.json): Evidence contract for human and AI research results.

## Research and contribution

- [Human explorer](https://naixu-guo.github.io/quantum-information-open-problems/): Browse fields, status, sources, formal statements, and progress.
- [Problem directory](https://naixu-guo.github.io/quantum-information-open-problems/problems/): One stable HTML page per record, including archived solved problems.
- [Contribution guide](https://github.com/Naixu-Guo/quantum-information-open-problems/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Review rules and required evidence.

## Optional

- [Source repository](https://github.com/Naixu-Guo/quantum-information-open-problems): Canonical articles, metadata, generators, and validation.
